1. (Currently amended) A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and an adhesive layer, the tool comprising first and second layers and __a first adhesive layer having a substantially uniform thickness produced by placing a sheet of adhesive having a substantially uniform thickness between the first and second layers, wherein the first adhesive layer is cured on the first layer and a second adhesive layer is cured on the second layer, the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer configured to be cured to each other__, the tool has a circular shape and further including cutting segments mounted to a perimeter of the tool, __a medial section positioned between the first and second layers, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer__.

2. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises __a honeycomb material bonded to fiber reinforced plastic material on at least one side of the honeycomb material__.

3. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 282 wherein the medial section is a composite material __formed by bonding the honeycomb material to the fiber reinforced plastic material during a curing process__.

4. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including __a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the cutting segments, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section and the cutting segments are welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring, and wherein the weld ring is continuous around the perimeter__.

5. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 further including __an inner ring coupled to an inner perimeter of the medial section, wherein the inner ring includes a central opening for accommodating a drive shaft__.

6. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 286 wherein the inner ring includes __a central opening__.

7. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including __a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the cutting segments, such that the cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring, wherein the weld ring is continuous around the perimeter, and wherein the weld ring comprises a plurality of segmented portions__.

8. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 294 wherein __each of the plurality of segmented portions of the weld ring is independently removable and replaceable__.
